column1: # compare-sources.tsv - for compare.sh: each machine's raw source records, read WITHOUT its lister (plain find, stat, awk, jq), so a lister that
# misses or invents a record shows as a difference. Columns: machine, a command that prints `<id><TAB><epoch>` (epoch empty when the source holds no time).
# It runs with STATE, DATA and CONFIG set. A machine with no row here is compared by count of its lister only and says so.

column2: for t in claude codex; do f=$STATE/$t-accounts.json; if [ -s "$f" ]; then jq -r --arg t $t --arg e "$(stat -c %Y "$f")" '.accounts[]? | "\($t).\(.id)\t\($e)"' "$f"; else printf '%s.unread\t\n' $t; fi; done
awk -F'\t' 'NF >= 5 && $1 ~ /^[0-9]+$/ { e[$2] = $1 } END { for (t in e) print t "\t" e[t] }' "$DATA/moves.log" 2>/dev/null
grep -l '^decision_keys=.' "$STATE"/*.meta 2>/dev/null | while read -r f; do printf '%s\t%s\n' "$(basename "$f" .meta)" "$(stat -c %Y "$f")"; done

find "$STATE" -mindepth 2 -maxdepth 2 -path '*.inbox/*.msg' -printf '%h\t%f\t%T@\n' | awk -F'\t' '{ d=$1; sub(/.*\//,"",d); sub(/\.inbox$/,"",d); n=$2; sub(/\.msg$/,"",n); e=$3; sub(/\..*/,"",e); print d ":" n "\t" e }'
awk -F'\t' 'NF >= 5 && $1 ~ /^[0-9]+$/ { e[$2] = $1 } END { for (t in e) print t "\t" e[t] }' "$DATA/moves.log" 2>/dev/null
sed -n 's/^- \([^ ]*\) - .*/\1/p' "$DATA/squad_leads.md" 2>/dev/null | while read -r i; do printf '%s\t%s\n' "$i" "$(stat -c %Y "$STATE/$i.meta" 2>/dev/null)"; done
awk -F'\t' 'NF >= 5 && $1 ~ /^[0-9]+$/ { e[$2] = $1 } END { for (t in e) print t "\t" e[t] }' "$DATA/moves.log" 2>/dev/null
while read -r k; do find "$STATE" -maxdepth 1 -name ".$k-*" -printf '%f\t%T@\n'; done < <(awk -F'\t' '$1 == "marker" { print $2 }' "$JG_MACHINES_TABLES/markers.tsv") | sed 's/\.[0-9]*$//'
